references.text: Also here it is mentioned that the Lord spoke to Moses on Mount Sinai, which links the laws in Leviticus to the revelation at Sinai.
A similar concluding formula confirming that the commandments were given by the Lord to Moses on Mount Sinai for the children of Israel.
The Lord gave Moses the law and commandments on stone tablets to teach the people, emphasizing Moses' role as mediator of God's law.
Moses proclaimed the laws, statutes, and commandments to the children of Israel after they left Egypt, paralleling the delivery of laws mentioned here.
The Lord instructed Moses to teach the people the commandments, laws, and statutes, confirming Moses' role as lawgiver on God's behalf.
Refers to the commandments, laws, and statutes that the Lord commanded Moses to teach the children of Israel.
Moses gave us the law as an inheritance for the congregation of Jacob, confirming that the law was given through Moses' hand.
Refers to the covenant the Lord made with the children of Israel when he brought them out of Egypt, linked to the legislation at Sinai.
The law was given through Moses, while grace and truth came through Jesus Christ, showing continuity between the delivery of the law and the new testament.
